tools.name: invariant_shield_scan
tools.description: Read-only AMM liquidity pool invariant scanner on Base Mainnet. Verifies Constant Product k = x * y with Decimal(78) precision to detect reserve manipulation or manipulative drain anomalies before swaps or rebalances. [HTTP 402: 0.1 USDC on Base]

tools.name: oracle_divergence_circuit_breaker
tools.description: Read-only oracle vs. on-chain DEX spot price divergence circuit breaker. Compares spot_price against reference_price within tolerance_bps (fail-closed) to detect oracle manipulation or stale feeds before execution. [HTTP 402: 0.05 USDC on Base]

tools.name: forensic_risk_scoring
tools.description: Read-only ERC-4626 vault and DeFi pool solvency scorer on Base Mainnet. Computes deterministic backing ratio, share-inflation flags, and reserve risk scores before deposits or withdrawals. [HTTP 402: 0.15 USDC on Base]

tools.name: dex_burst_volume_detector
tools.description: Read-only flash-loan burst and reentrancy depth telemetry analyzer on Base Mainnet. Evaluates suspicious tx_hash borrow volume and call stack depth to classify exploit severity. [HTTP 402: 0.05 USDC on Base]

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: oracle_divergence_circuit_breaker · Private data: forensic_risk_scoring · Public sink: forensic_risk_scoring.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: oracle_divergence_circuit_breaker · Private data: forensic_risk_scoring · Public sink: forensic_risk_scoring

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
